data.body:
Investigation (origin/main 8118570bc46; gate code identical to the repro tree). No code change; the fix needs a design choice, escalated to the operator.

Repro: offline FakeRunner, real signed attestations, an epic with 2 task children, `require_plan_review_for_close` and `enforce_plan_material_pins` on.
- A. Children reviewed, then the epic reviewed, then both children claimed and closed, with nothing edited: the epic close gate is `certified`. Closing a child does not move its own pin or the epic's material: closed children stay plan material (`counts_as_plan_material_child` excludes only archived and deleted children), and box state is normalized out.
- B. A closed child's description is edited: `stale-pin-drift`. `sign-review` refuses ("a dependency's plan material changed").
- C. The epic description is edited and a child is added: `stale-material` (description 291 -> 309, children 2 -> 3). `sign-review` refuses.
- D. A fresh `review-plan` of the in_progress epic with every child closed: PASS, signed, 10 runner calls (11 for the first review). The close then succeeds.
- `--ref` retargets only the completion verifier. CLOSE already ignores code drift, so `--ref` has no effect on this gate.

Corrections to the description:
- `verify.completion_floor_active = true` is set in the committed rebar.toml (commit 9b933e6c2f8, 2026-07-13). The floor drops advisory findings only. It cannot change PASS or BLOCK and does not shorten the review.
- Pin drift on e12f came from edits to the children's plans, not from the closes. Its own-material drift came from a description re-scope (3539 -> 5626 chars) and from adding children (5 -> 9).

Prior intent: unpurified-wolflike-flycatcher (2bbd) defines the close gate's purpose as preventing "an implemented ticket from closing after its own plan or a pinned upstream plan changed during execution". Re-review is the remedy it designed. No ticket, ADR, or doc defines a cheaper epic-close path. A search for "graph verification" finds no such concept in src or docs.

Survey of 203 non-administrative closed epics updated since the close gate was enabled (7650f579b27, 2026-07-22): 69 closed under an execution-phase plan-review attestation, meaning a review run after claim. 62 have no plan-review attestation. The execution phase does not prove a given review was the close-time re-review.
